gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could open states what the plain 70mai A810 (its $109.99 top pick in the second chat) records once the rear camera is attached: the front drops from 4K 30 fps to 4K 25 fps, the rear is 1080p 25 fps at 8 Mbps on a SmartSens SC200AI, and the camera runs on a 500 mAh battery, not a supercapacitor.
standout_why: I could read four of the result pages: dashcamtalk.com/best-dash-cams (cited), knowledgelib.io (cited), carcody.com (cited) and productbible.com. Rivals already have part of it: knowledgelib and DashCamTalk's list both give the 30 to 24/25 fps dual-channel drop, but only for the A810 Lite. carcody gives the 500 mAh battery, but only for the A510. productbible gives the Vantrue S1 Pro's per-channel figures and its first-generation STARVIS rear sensor. None gives the A810's both-cameras figures or battery, none puts 'both cameras recording' figures side by side, and knowledgelib gives no hardwire kit price for any model. I could not open dashpicked.com (cited), caranddriver.com under-$170 (cited), thecargearguide.com, dashanddrive.com, garagerated.com, lens-rumors.com or vortexradar.com (certificate errors or blocked), so the score stays at 1; it would be 2 if those pages lack it too.
decides: ChatGPT says it wants a supercapacitor, then picks the A810, which 70mai's own page lists with a 500 mAh battery and which DashCamTalk measured at 25 fps on both channels with the rear attached. On the both-cameras line the Vantrue S1 Pro 2CH (partner store, $135.99 in the brief's table) wins the 'both channels at 30 fps plus supercapacitor' segment, but those S1 Pro figures come from productbible, not from Vantrue's page. The 70mai keeps the 'most front pixels' segment (3840x2160 on a Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678) at 25 fps; the A810S has the capacitor but DashCamTalk lists it at $159.99, over the line. The Botslab G980H 4K + 2K (partner store, $133.99 before code AA18) is a 25 fps-by-default 4K front on a Sony IMX415 with a 64 GB card in the box. None of the five dash cams we already link is at or under $150 through our link (the nearest is the DDPAI N5 Pro at $157.52), so the page needs a new partner record: Vantrue S1 Pro 2CH, Botslab G980H dual, or DDPAI Z50 Pro Dual GPS ($149.00 before SAVEBIGBF).
